component.name: Macet Secure Chat
component.summary: Private and secure messenger - no user IDs (not even random numbers)

ul.li: end-to-end encrypted messages, with editing, replies and deletion of messages.
sending end-to-end encrypted images and files.
secret chat groups - only group members know it exists and who is the member.
end-to-end encrypted audio and video calls.
portable chat profile - you can transfer your chat contacts and history to another device.
encrypted app database and files in the app storage (except videos).

Full privacy of your identity, profile, contacts and metadata: unlike any other existing messaging platform, it uses no phone numbers or any other identifiers assigned to the users - not even random numbers. This protects the privacy of who you are communicating with, hiding it from the servers and from any observers.
Complete protection against spam and abuse: as you have no identifier on the platform, you cannot be contacted unless you share a one-time invitation link or an optional temporary user address.
Full ownership, control and security of your data: all user data is stored on client devices, the messages are only held temporarily on the relay servers until they are received.

description.p: You can connect to anybody you know via link or scan QR code (in the video call or in person) and start sending messages instantly - no emails, phone numbers or passwords needed.
Your profile and contacts are only stored in the app on your device.
All messages are end-to-end encrypted using the open-source double-ratchet protocol; the messages are routed via the Macet servers using the open-source SimpleX Messaging Protocol.
